title: trakt
tagline: Transforming traditional rental agreements and invoices into tradeable blockchain assets
description: Trakt is a revolutionary blockchain-powered protocol built on Aptos for the tokenization, funding, and credit scoring of legal contracts, with initial templates for rental agreements and freelancer invoices.Trakt enables the fractional ownership and funding of future real-world income streams—with transparent on-chain credit scoring—building a circular economy where tenants, freelancers, owners, and lenders all benefit from verifiable reliability and trust.
how_its_made:
CreditTracker contract continually maintains up-to-date credit scores for each contract and each user (tenant, freelancer, owner).
Scores are dynamic: Updated in real time as payments are made/missed, insurance events occur, disputes are logged, and contracts close.
Transparency: Scores and ratings are always available on-chain for any party—removing bias and manual filtering.
